name: Ruk-Com Cloud PaaS
line: Deploy managed container apps and databases on Virtuozzo PaaS.

free.text: Trial account; length/credit not stated; upgrade to continue

cells.regions: Thailand, Singapore, Japan, France; privacy lists TH/SG

work.math: THB253.31 is 2 cloudlets plus one IP address for 730 hours, at THB0.0685 per cloudlet hour and THB0.21 per IP hour. 100 build minutes and builder resources are not priced.
THB553.34 is 8 cloudlets plus one IP address for 730 hours, before 7% VAT. 8 cloudlets give 1 GiB of RAM, but do not guarantee 1 vCPU. Build use is extra.
THB953.38 is the subtotal for 8 + 8 cloudlets and one IP address, before 7% VAT. Layers are billed separately. Daily 7-copy backups need an extra storage node that is not priced.
